metadata.question: Does the green leaf area in China increase during 2017 compared to 2000?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about green leaf area in China comparing 2017 to 2000. This is a vegetation monitoring question that would typically use NDVI (Normalized Difference Vegetation Index) as a proxy for green leaf area. Strategy: 1. Use MODIS vegetation indices (MOD13Q1 or MOD13A1) which have good temporal coverage from 2000 onward 2. Define China geometry using FAO boundaries 3. Compare mean NDVI between 2000 and 2017 4. Handle potential data gaps with fallback options Data Quality Checks: - Check if collections have images for both years - Check if there are valid pixels after processing - Validate that NDVI values are in reasonable range (-1 to 1) I'll use MOD13Q1 (250m, 16-day) which has data from 2000 and covers the entire period. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const china = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level0') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'China')); const year2000 = ee.DateRange('2000-01-01', '2000-12-31'); const year2017 = ee.DateRange('2017-01-01', '2017-12-31'); // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Vegetation Index function getYearlyNDVI(yearRange) { const collection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD13Q1') .filterBounds(china) .filterDate(yearRange) .select('NDVI'); if (collection.size().getInfo() === 0) { return null; } // Calculate annual mean NDVI const meanImg = collection.mean().multiply(0.0001); // Scale factor return meanImg; } // Get NDVI for both years const ndvi2000 = getYearlyNDVI(year2000); const ndvi2017 = getYearlyNDVI(year2017); // Check for empty collections if (!ndvi2000 || !ndvi2017) { console.log("2000 Images: 0"); console.log("2017 Images: 0"); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate mean NDVI over China const reducer = ee.Reducer.mean(); const stats2000 = ndvi2000.reduceRegion({ reducer: reducer, geometry: china, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2017 = ndvi2017.reduceRegion({ reducer: reducer, geometry: china, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const mean2000 = stats2000.get('NDVI').getInfo(); const mean2017 = stats2017.get('NDVI').getInfo(); // Check for no valid pixels if (mean2000 === null || mean2017 === null) { console.log("No valid pixels in one or both years"); console.log("C2"); return; } // Check for calculation failure if (mean2000 === undefined || mean2017 === undefined || isNaN(mean2000) || isNaN(mean2017) || mean2000 > 1 || mean2000 < -1 || mean2017 > 1 || mean2017 < -1) { console.log("Calculation failure - invalid NDVI values"); console.log("C3"); return; } // 4. Output results and final answer console.log(`2000 Mean NDVI: ${mean2000.toFixed(4)}`); console.log(`2017 Mean NDVI: ${mean2017.toFixed(4)}`); console.log(`Change: ${(mean2017 - mean2000).toFixed(4)}`); // Determine answer based on NDVI increase if (mean2017 > mean2000) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
